The '''''Elpi''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that was used part [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]]

==History==
The ''Elpi'' was located on the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[ZA-13]], which was responsible for manufacturing [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|Engines]]. During the [[Attack on ZA-13]], the transport carrying [[Officer/Legends|officers]] loyal to Zaarin, launched from the hanger of ZA-13 and attempted to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. However, the transport was disabled by a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]], piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], and an [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort Shuttle]] [[Omega 1]] boarded the transport and captured it, sending it back to the facility.

==Behind the scenes==
The transport is called '''Z-Elpi''' to remind the player that the transport belongs to Zaarin.
